# laravelforge_scheduled_job (Resource)

Manages a scheduled job (cron job) on a Laravel Forge server. Scheduled jobs are immutable: the Forge API exposes no update endpoint, so any change to a configured attribute replaces the job.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `command` (String) Command the job executes.
- `frequency` (String) How often the job runs. Sent lowercase: one of `minutely`, `hourly`, `nightly`, `weekly`, `monthly`, `reboot`, `custom`. When `custom`, also set `cron`.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server to create the scheduled job on.
- `user` (String) System user the command runs as (e.g. `root`).

### Optional

- `cron` (String) Cron expression. Required when `frequency` is `custom`; for preset frequencies Forge generates it.
- `name` (String) Optional job name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the scheduled job.
- `next_run_time` (String) Timestamp of the next scheduled run.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status (e.g. `installing`, `installed`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
